photos.title: Bay View Resort from above
photos.what: Bay View Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the tower, with a gray roof and blue stripes, stands on the oceanfront in the middle; a larger white-roofed building stands to its north-east; the Boardwalk, the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Bay View Resort from above, on the oceanfront next to the Boardwalk.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Bay View Resort tower on the oceanfront in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-a NAIP records (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and added labels placed from map data

annotation_sources.Bay View Resort: middle of the 183 Horry County parcel boxes of BAYVIEW HPR PH I (-78.883317, 33.687986), flood.json footprint_center, parcels-bayview.json; label.py
annotation_sources.Atlantic Ocean: given point in the water (-78.881466, 33.68731); label.py

photos.original_size: 1600x1200 crop of a 2400x1800 NAIP export, labels drawn, then resized
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/bay-view-resort/ on 2026-11-14, and checked against the county parcel outlines drawn on the same frame (the outline sits on the gray-roofed tower). It shows: the tower with blue stripes at the label, a larger white-roofed building to its north-east, the Boardwalk and beach, the Atlantic Ocean. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of the unlabelled crop by tools/photos.js crops, so the share image carries no text.
